records.public_claim_text: The BCBS published the final revised standard in July 2024.20 The GHOS agreed to defer implementation of the standard by one year to 1 January 2026, to ensure that all members can implement the standard in a full, timely and consistent manner.

records.public_claim_text: In July 2024, the BCBS also finalised the disclosure standard for banks’ crypto-asset exposures.21 The standard requires banks to disclose qualitative information on their activities related to crypto-assets and quantitative information on their exposures to crypto-assets and the related capital and liquidity requirements.
